versions.content: Ethernet SW Driver shall call EthIf_TxConfirmation with Result set to E_OK to indicate a successful transmission; either from the Interrupt routine (in interrupt mode) or from the Eth_TxConfirmation routine in polling mode (if the notification has been enabled).
